edits.before: Q off minions to chip the duo — the angles are the lane and every wave drops souls.
edits.after: Q outranges Tongue Lash; poke freely and punish his short auto range.

edits.before: Soul discipline begins: collect what's safe; the range grows forever.
edits.after: Thick Skin's shield only absorbs so much — keep landing Q through it.

edits.before: W threats open: any clumped trade risks the spreading root.
edits.after: Your root beats his Tongue Lash in a straight poke war before Abyssal Dive is live.

edits.before: Late Senna out-ranges the game from the support slot — souls, beams, and mist.
edits.after: Anti-heal and global R let you out-damage his sustain and punish any dive.

edits.before: - Tahm Kench Abyssal Dive: matchup-defining — His re-engage and his escape — all-in only while it is down. It writes your spacing rules. - E Curse of the Black Mist is for saving fights, not seasoning trades. - The R opens or closes fights — pick one per cast.
edits.after: Abyssal Dive (W) is down 21s at rank 1, falling to 17s at rank 5 — his only gap-closer. Tongue Lash (Q) applies Grievous Wounds too, so time your all-ins around its 5-7s cooldown.

edits.before: His engage hunts your pickups — collect behind cover and root the chain that commits.
edits.after: He eats your ADC through a knockup — root his engage, punish Thick Skin's shield, and buy anti-heal early.

edits.before: Survive the pickup tax and out-range the rest of his game. Abyssal Dive is the 2v2’s metronome — read it before stepping up.
edits.after: Deny Abyssal Dive's setup and out-poke him before his grey-health regen ramps.

edits.before: Tahm Kench wins by landing Abyssal Dive, denying your pattern, and starting one clean chain and letting it pay the whole lane.
edits.after: Tahm Kench wins by landing Abyssal Dive to set up Devour, and out-sustaining your poke with Thick Skin and grey health.

edits.before: - Senna vs Tahm Kench - Track: Tahm Kench Abyssal Dive. - Track his engage cooldown — your duo trades only when it's down. - Abyssal Dive spent means windows open. - Keep the ult for the swing moment.
edits.after: - Senna vs Tahm Kench - Track: Abyssal Dive (W) cooldown — his only engage. - Devour can eat your ADC outright; hold root for his approach. - Thick Skin's shield eats chip; anti-heal answers his sustain. - Poke early, before grey health ramps.
